mapping_relation is a source relationship at source_commit: candidate_partial means connected source exists for a bounded related behavior; planned means a mapped capability is missing; ambiguous means its semantics or role cannot yet be assigned decisively. Only vendor activation/session administration is excluded among these records. Hosted creation, rigging, AI, templates, content acquisition and local equivalents stay in scope; storefront-only exclusion requires evidence and later reviewed scope adjudication.

The new vendor account-switch action is excluded session administration; its preferences category and all substantive creation/content/extension workflows remain inventoried. Read-only preference values are current configuration, not factory constants, tested bindings, calibrated units or a selected numeric locale/language.

The later paired partial/reversal cases retain their own input/capture qualifications. Driver outcomes and observed authoring effects remain separate. Current seam values and visible labels do not establish factory defaults, ranges, unprinted units, continuous correspondence, physical effects or process restart.

Flat, Apply Turned Sewing Line Type, Show 3D Pattern and Hide All 3D Patterns retain new exact IDs alongside earlier labels. Group membership is an engineering handoff, not an alias/equivalence finding. curves.scope: Exact cubic split retains legacy seam remapping and rewrites every affected group span in traversal order, including reversed spans and endpoint splits. mesh.scope: Revision-tagged conforming triangle rest mesh with authored boundary parameters; sibling sewing.rs derives arc-length group portions and weighted stitches, preserving both one-sided disconnected knots. No editable retopology/quads or reference tessellation identity is claimed.

Use f64 authoring/CPU simulation and SI metres/kilograms/seconds, Y-up. Rest meshes, accepted solver state, display/output layers and caches carry construction revision/identity and never replace authoritative editability.

The reference owner has the exclusive native input lease; implementation owners receive only reviewed public behavior contracts, original fixtures and permitted evidence. No raw proprietary code/account/UI record is an implementation input.
